description:
Peter Parker’s powers begin changing in unexpected ways in this scene from Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2026).

After years of relying on mechanical web-shooters, Peter experiences what can only be described as a second stage of his spider mutation — a kind of “arachnid puberty.” His senses become dramatically heightened, his Spider-Sense intensifies, and his body begins producing organic webbing for the first time.

Unlike Tobey Maguire’s Spider-Man, who developed organic webs immediately after gaining his powers, Tom Holland’s Peter had always used web fluid and technology of his own design. This new transformation marks a major evolution for the MCU version of Spider-Man, pushing his abilities beyond anything he has experienced before.

As Peter struggles to understand and control the changes, the scene explores the idea that his spider powers are still developing — turning an already powerful Spider-Man into something even more instinctive, unpredictable, and dangerous.
